title: Oscar and the Playlist
author: Vesper Nystrom
blurb: Odile Eastwick, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
